findings.title: Import cycle member
findings.evidence: Participates in a circular import dependency (mutually reachable modules).
findings.recommendation: Break the cycle: extract shared types, invert a dependency, or defer an import.

findings.title: Hub module (imported by 30)
findings.evidence: 30 modules depend on this one; churn here is high-blast-radius.
findings.recommendation: Keep it stable and small; move volatile logic out.

findings.title: Deep nesting (depth 9)
findings.evidence: Max indentation depth 9 - control flow is hard to follow.
findings.recommendation: Flatten with early returns / guard clauses; extract inner blocks.

findings.title: Broad exception handling
findings.evidence: Bare or Exception-wide `except` swallows errors indiscriminately.
findings.recommendation: Catch specific exceptions; re-raise or log the rest.
